description: Independent hand-derived reference checkpoints for Nimphy STEP-009 differential reference verification.
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC REFERENCE CHECKPOINTS ONLY. Independently hand-derived using exact BigInt rational arithmetic. Not generated from production engine.

checkpoints.description: Exact half-cent rounding tie under round_half_up rounding away from zero
checkpoints.derivation: List price $3.05 (305 cents) in standard_mid 70% royalty tier yields exact rational 305 * 7/10 = 2135/10 = 427/2 = 213.5 cents. Exact tie of .5 under round_half_up rounds away from zero to 214 cents. Delivery cost for 1.0 MB at 15 cents/MB is 15 cents. Unit contribution = 214 - 15 = 199 cents.

checkpoints.description: Exact half-cent rounding tie under round_half_even rounding to nearest even integer (220.5 -> 220)
checkpoints.derivation: List price $3.15 (315 cents) at 70% rate yields exact rational 315 * 7/10 = 2205/10 = 441/2 = 220.5 cents. Under round_half_even (Banker's rounding), 220 is even, so 220.5 rounds to 220 cents (unlike round_half_up which rounds to 221). Delivery cost is 15 cents. Unit contribution = 220 - 15 = 205 cents.

checkpoints.description: Exact half-cent rounding tie under round_half_even rounding to nearest even integer where quotient is odd (213.5 -> 214)
checkpoints.derivation: List price 305 cents at 70% yields 213.5 cents. Integer part 213 is odd, so Banker's rounding rounds up to 214 cents (even). Delivery cost = 15 cents. Contribution = 214 - 15 = 199 cents.

checkpoints.description: Rounding under round_down truncating towards zero on exact half-cent values
checkpoints.derivation: List price 315 cents at 70% yields 220.5 cents -> round_down truncates to 220 cents. Delivery cost for 0.5 MB is 15 * 1/2 = 7.5 cents -> round_down truncates to 7 cents. Contribution = 220 - 7 = 213 cents.

checkpoints.description: Rounding under round_up rounding away from zero on fractional values
checkpoints.derivation: List price 315 cents at 70% yields 220.5 cents -> round_up rounds away from zero to 221 cents. Delivery cost for 0.5 MB is 7.5 cents -> round_up rounds away from zero to 8 cents. Contribution = 221 - 8 = 213 cents.

checkpoints.description: Multi-unit scenario aggregation under per_total rounding point with cost variance
checkpoints.derivation: Hardcover €20.00 (2000 cents) at 100 pages. Base cost 600 + (100 - 75) * 3 = 675 cents. +10% cost variance yields 675 * 110/100 = 742.5 cents per unit. Royalty 50% = 1000 cents per unit. 7 units: total exact royalty = 7 * 1000 = 7000 cents; total exact cost = 7 * 742.5 = 5197.5 cents. Under round_down per_total: gross royalty = 7000, production cost = 5197, net contribution = 7000 - 5197 = 1803 cents. Revenue = 7 * 2000 = 14000 cents.

checkpoints.description: Reachable break-even with exact integer division (zero remainder)
checkpoints.derivation: List price $15.00 (1500 cents) with 60% royalty = 900 cents. Print cost for 100 pages = 100 + (100 - 24) * 2 = 252 cents. Unit contribution = 900 - 252 = 648 cents. Fixed cost $648.00 (64800 cents). Division: 64800 / 648 = 100 units exactly (remainder 0). Break-even revenue = 100 * 1500 = 150000 cents ($1,500.00).

checkpoints.description: Reachable break-even requiring integer ceiling due to positive remainder
checkpoints.derivation: Unit contribution = 648 cents. Fixed cost = 65000 cents. Division: 65000 / 648 = 100 with remainder 200 cents. Ceiling requires 100 + 1 = 101 units. Break-even revenue = 101 * 1500 = 151500 cents ($1,515.00).

checkpoints.description: Unreachable break-even due to negative unit contribution
checkpoints.derivation: List price $5.00 (500 cents) at 60% = 300 cents royalty. Print cost for 300 pages = 100 + (300 - 24) * 2 = 652 cents. Unit contribution = 300 - 652 = -352 cents (negative). Break-even is mathematically unreachable; unitContributionMinor = -352, breakEvenUnits = null.

checkpoints.description: Multi-driver sensitivity analysis with deterministic ranking across three drivers
checkpoints.derivation: Baseline $9.99 70% yields 699 cents royalty - 15 delivery = 684 cents * 1000 units = 684,000 cents. units delta 100 gives +/-68,400 impact. listPrice -100 yields $8.99 (629-15 = 614 * 1000 = 614,000, delta -70,000); listPrice +100 yields $10.99 in 35% tier (385-15 = 370 * 1000 = 370,000, delta -314,000), max impact 314,000. costVariance delta 50% gives delivery 8 cents (lower contrib 691,000, delta +7000) and 23 cents (upper contrib 676,000, delta -8000), max impact 8000. Deterministic ranking: 1. listPriceMinor (314,000), 2. units (68,400), 3. costVariancePercent (8,000).

checkpoints.description: Unreachable break-even due to exactly zero unit contribution
checkpoints.derivation: List price $5.00 (500 cents) at 60% royalty = 300 cents. Print cost for 124 pages: base 100 + (124 - 24) * 2 = 300 cents. Unit contribution = 300 - 300 = 0 cents. Break-even is mathematically unreachable because unit contribution is zero; reachable: false, unreachableReason: 'ZERO_CONTRIBUTION', breakEvenUnits: null.

checkpoints.description: Multi-driver sensitivity analysis exercising exact impact-score ties and deterministic alphabetical ordering
checkpoints.derivation: Baseline $10.00 (1000 cents), 24 pages (print cost = 100 cents), 1000 units yields royalty 600 - 100 = 500 cents * 1000 units = 500,000 cents net contribution and 1,000,000 cents revenue. costVariancePercent perturbation 60% yields lower cost 40 cents (contrib 560,000, delta +60,000) and upper cost 160 cents (contrib 440,000, delta -60,000), impact 60,000. listPriceMinor perturbation 100 cents yields lower price $9.00 (royalty 540 - 100 = 440, contrib 440,000, delta -60,000) and upper price $11.00 (royalty 660 - 100 = 560, contrib 560,000, delta +60,000), impact 60,000. units perturbation 120 units yields lower units 880 (contrib 440,000, delta -60,000) and upper units 1120 (contrib 560,000, delta +60,000), impact 60,000. All three drivers produce exact identical impactScoreMinor = 60000. Deterministic UTF-16 code-point order breaks the three-way tie: costVariancePercent (rank 1), listPriceMinor (rank 2), units (rank 3).

checkpoints.description: Triad scenario calculation (low, base, high) with exact totals and monotonic ordering
checkpoints.derivation: Paperback 24 pages has base print cost 100 cents. Royalty is 60%. Low: 100 units @ $10.00, +10% cost (110 cents/unit) -> revenue $1,000 (100000 cents), gross royalty 60000, cost 11000, contribution 49000. Base: 200 units @ $15.00, 0% cost (100 cents/unit) -> revenue $3,000 (300000 cents), gross royalty 180000, cost 20000, contribution 160000. High: 500 units @ $20.00, -10% cost (90 cents/unit) -> revenue $10,000 (1000000 cents), gross royalty 600000, cost 45000, contribution 555000. Monotonic input ordering (price 1000<=1500<=2000, units 100<=200<=500, cost variance 10>=0>=-10) and total ordering (revenue 100k<=300k<=1000k, contribution 49k<=160k<=555k) both hold true.

checkpoints.description: Valid scenario totals near Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER without precision loss
checkpoints.derivation: Hardcover €20.00 (2000 cents) at 75 pages. Base print cost = 600 cents. 50% royalty tier = 1000 cents. Unit contribution = 400 cents. At 4,503,599,627,370 units, total retail revenue is 4,503,599,627,370 * 2000 = 9,007,199,254,740,000 cents, within 991 cents of Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (9,007,199,254,740,091). Gross royalty = 4,503,599,627,370,000 cents; print cost = 2,702,159,776,422,000 cents; net contribution = 1,801,439,850,948,000 cents. All values are valid safe integers that do not overflow.
